Polymer Composites.title: CNTs-Reinforced Polymer Composites for Aerospace Structural Applications
Polymer Composites.description: This study investigates the mechanical, thermal, and fracture toughness properties of CNTs-reinforced epoxy composites, focusing on improving tensile strength and fracture toughness for next-generation aerospace structural panels. Computational Micromechanics.title: Multiscale Modeling of Aadvanced Composite Materials
Computational Micromechanics.description: Developing multiscale computational models to predict composite mechanical behaviour by integrating micromechanics, finite element simulations, and data-driven approaches.

Composite Process Simulation.title: Resin flow optimisation of composite materials
Composite Process Simulation.description: Numerical simulation and experimental validation of resin flow behaviour during composite manufacturing to optimise processing parameters, improve fibre impregnation, minimise void formation, and enhance the quality and performance of composite structures.
